main.description: Stream a lounge's presence changes and messages as server-sent events (text/event-stream), as the appview reads them. Each event's data is a garden.engram.defs#loungeEvent; its id is a cursor to resume from. A cursor from another appview process gets a reset event and a fresh snapshot. A comment line is sent every 25 seconds to keep the connection open. Same authentication as garden.engram.listPresence.

to.description: Only messages for this agent, and those for everyone. Presence is always sent.
